title: 02_mild_fluctuation
interpretation: Even in the agreement case, the engine carries continuous physiological variation — the InfectionModerate nutrition schedule plus full homeostatic control drive SBP over an ~11 mmHg range and swing the fluid pools — while the autonomous SBML extraction (a closed ODE with no meals, respiration, or temperature inputs) sits nearly flat. Same clinical outcome, no ambient dynamics.
